description: This file contains an extension for VoiceWakeOverlayController that manages the overlay window's presentation, positioning, and behavior. It handles UI presentation, window setup, z-ordering, frame calculations, and dismissal animations related to the voice wake overlay feature on macOS.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Manages the presentation of the overlay window, making it visible and configuring it with the appropriate view hierarchy.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the overlay window if it doesn't already exist, setting up its content and appearance.

methods.name: bringToFrontIfVisible
methods.description: Brings the overlay window to the front if it is currently visible.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the target frame for positioning the overlay window on the main screen.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window's frame to match the target frame, optionally with animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the height needed for the overlay based on its contents.

methods.name: dismissTargetFrame
methods.description: Determines the target frame for dismissing or modifying the overlay window based on certain reasons and outcomes.
